punchline: Simons got fired for disagreeing with his general, and it was fine.
thirty_sec: At the Institute for Defense Analyses Simons helped the NSA break Soviet codes, spending half his time on his own mathematics. After he publicly opposed the Vietnam War his boss, General Maxwell Taylor, had him fired, and he moved to Stony Brook.
question: If your current job ended next month, which piece of your own work would make the next one easy to find?
key_contrast: A letter to the Times cost him the job; his own mathematics kept him employable.
